bills.title: Plenary passes amendment to the Court Organization Act
bills.summary: The plenary approved measures covering 국회사무처는 「개인정보 보호법」에 따라 정보주체의 개인정보 및 권익을 보호하고, 개인정보와 관련한 정보주체의 고충을 원활하게 처리할 수 있도록 다음과 같은 개인정보 처리방침을 두고 있습니다.; 소관업무 : 개인정보 침해사실 신고, 상담신청; 홈페이지 : privacy.kisa.or.kr.
key_points: 국회사무처는 「개인정보 보호법」에 따라 정보주체의 개인정보 및 권익을 보호하고, 개인정보와 관련한 정보주체의 고충을 원활하게 처리할 수 있도록 다음과 같은 개인정보 처리방침을 두고 있습니다.
주소 : (58324) 전라남도 나주시 진흥길 9 (빛가람동 301-2) 3층 개인정보침해 신고센터

items.title: Amendment to the Court Organization Act
items.summary: The amendment increases the number of Supreme Court justices and changes the jurisdiction over telecom-based financial fraud cases to single-judge courts. As of 2022, the Supreme Court received more than 56,000 cases annually, with each justice handling nearly 5,000 cases per year.

items.title: Amendment to the Constitutional Court Act
items.summary: The amendment allows constitutional complaints to be filed against court judgments under certain conditions. Under the current law, individuals may file constitutional complaints when their fundamental rights are infringed upon by the exercise or non-exercise of public authority.

items.summary:

items.title: Amendment to the Civil Act
items.summary: The amendment allows all heirs—including lineal ascendants, descendants, and spouses—to be subject to disqualification from inheritance if they seriously violate their duty of support toward the decedent, commit a serious crime(s), or engage in grossly unfair treatment. Previously, the Constitutional Court had ruled that provisions in the Civil Act, which failed to separately specify grounds for forfeiture of the…

items.title: Special Act on Strengthening Support for Essential Medical Services and Lessening Regional Disparities*
items.summary: This Act intends to guarantee essential medical services for all citizens and lessen disparities between regions. It defines “essential medical services” as medical services directly related to the life and health of the people and that require policy-driven support by the Minister of Health and Welfare, in consideration of their urgency and importance.

items.title: Amendment to the Equal Employment Opportunity and Work-Family Balance Assistance Act
items.summary: The amendment allows spouses to take leave from work in cases of miscarriage or stillbirth, as well as pre- and post-natal leave. Under the current law only female employees are granted leave for miscarriage or stillbirth, depending on the stage of pregnancy, and no provision exists for their spouses.

items.title: Amendment to the Elementary and Secondary Education Act
items.summary: The amendment mandates the installation of video information processing devices (CCTV or closed-caption TV) in designated essential areas within school buildings—excluding classrooms—and strengthens safety management for students participating in after-school activities. Following the death of an elementary school student in Daejeon in February 2025, concerns were raised about the need to install CCTV systems both…

items.title: Amendment to the Act on Protection, Support and Commemoration Projects for Sexual Slavery Victims of the Japanese Imperial Army
items.summary:
The amendment intends to commemorate victims of sexual slavery who were drafted for the Japanese Imperial Army and to prohibit defamation against them. It defines their damage as “damage suffered by individuals who were forcibly mobilized by Imperial Japan, subjected to sexual abuse, and compelled to live as so-called ‘comfort women.’”
 
 
The Minister of Gender Equality and Family is required to conduct…

items.title: Amendment to the Act on the Guarantee of Employees’ Retirement Benefits
items.summary: The amendment expands eligibility for the SME Retirement Pension Fund Plan (“Blue Seed”) and strengthens criminal penalties for delayed payment of retirement benefits. Introduced in 2022 as Korea’s only public fund-type retirement pension, the “Blue Seed” fund has performed very well, recording an annual return of 8.67% in 2025.

items.title: Act on Promoting Online Wholesale Transactions of Agricultural and Fisheries Products*
items.summary: The approved Act establishes a legal framework for online wholesale markets for agricultural and fisheries products, in an effort to ensure stable operations and innovate distribution structures. The Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs has proposed the transition to online wholesale distribution as a key national policy task, and the Korea Agro-Fisheries & Food Trade Corporation currently operates an…

items.title: Amendment to the Tramway Transportation Act
items.summary: The amended Act strengthens the public status and safety of the tramway (cable railway) business, which is widely recognized as being a public good. The legislative measure follows concerns voiced that some tramway businesses have been operating in a monopolistic manner, without a fixed validity period, while insufficiently contributing to the public interest.

items.summary: The amendments establish an issuance and distribution framework for Security Tokens to facilitate fractional investment in real estate, music copyrights, fine art, and other assets. items.title: Amendment to the Framework Act on the Management of Disasters and Safety
items.summary: The amended Framework Act provides the legal basis for establishing a Central Joint Disaster Victim Support Center to assist victims of large-scale disasters and their families, and for conducting surveys assessing disaster recovery levels. The head of the Central Disaster and Safety Countermeasures Headquarters may establish and operate a Central Joint Disaster Victim Support Center—such as in the cases of the…

items.title: Amendment to the Special Act on the Redevelopment and Support of Aging Planed Cities
items.summary: The amendment supports the expedited implementation of redevelopment projects aimed at the comprehensive and systematic redevelopment of aging planned cities. Following the enactment (December 26, 2023) and enforcement (April 27, 2024) of the Special Act, redevelopment projects have been underway in first-generation new towns and other aging planned cities.

items.summary: The amended Act transfers the Aviation and Railway Accident Investigation Board from under the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport to under the Office of the Prime Minister. items.summary: The amendment expands the scope of child-related institutions subject to employment restrictions for individuals with prior child abuse convictions to include alternative education institutions registered with the superintendent of education of a Metropolitan City or a Province pursuant to the Act on Alternative Educational Institution. items.summary: The amendment to the Act on the Prevention of and Countermeasures against Agricultural and Fishery Disasters centers on enabling the government to compensate for production costs incurred before a disaster occurs. Current disaster-support standards have been criticized for failing to reflect actual losses.

items.title: Act on Supporting Structural Reform of Private Universities*
items.summary: The Act on Supporting Structural Reform of Private Universities aims to provide systematic support for the restructuring of private universities and incorporated educational foundations. Closures of local private universities due to financial distress have repercussions that extend far beyond the impacts on students and faculty, including diminished regional research capacity and economic impact to local communities.

items.summary: The approved Act clarifies the legal basis for the financial and administrative support necessary for the establishment and operation of village enterprises and establishes grounds for devising comprehensive plans to support them in a systematic manner.
